journal.title: Fresh start: $1,000 cash; strategy set with Vamsi
journal.body:
Round 1 is closed and archived in archive/round1/h1b/ (ledger, journal, config, watchlist). This book restarts at $1,000 cash with no positions.
Finish line: the Mon Oct 5, 4:00 PM ET close unless Vamsi sets a new window.
Strategy: Vamsi is setting it. No position until it is in place; every trade gets a journal entry that cites the rule it follows.

checks.label: Cash account only (no margin, no shorting)
checks.detail: Balance under the $2,000 FINRA margin minimum, so margin isn't available anyway.

checks.label: Stocks and ETFs only
checks.detail: Includes leveraged and inverse ETFs. No options or other derivatives.

checks.label: No good-faith violations (T+1 settlement)
checks.detail: 0 violations. Shares bought with unsettled sale proceeds are not sold before those proceeds settle.

checks.label: Personal account, investor tax treatment
checks.detail: No trading for others, no pay, no trader-tax-status (IRC 475) election. Those, not trade count, are what would turn trading into unauthorized self-employment on H-1B.

checks.label: Activity tracked in the open
checks.detail: 0 orders so far (0 today), 0 day trades. No legal cap applies to trading your own account.

checks.label: No OFAC-restricted (NS-CMIC) securities
checks.detail: Rule for anyone physically in the US, H-1B holders included.
